description: This file contains routing utilities and route definitions for FastAPI, including implementation of request handling, websocket handling, and class definitions for routes and routers. It also manages dependencies, route matching, and OpenAPI integration.
external_files: starlette.routing (imported multiple times for classes like BaseRoute, Match, compile_path, get_name)

classes.name: APIWebSocketRoute
classes.description: A WebSocket route class that extends Starlette's WebSocketRoute to include dependency injection and path matching logic.

classes.name: APIRoute
classes.description: A class representing an API route, including path, endpoint, response model, dependencies, and the method to generate the route handler.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: A router class extending Starlette's Router to manage multiple routes, including support for prefix, dependencies, tags, and inclusion of other routers.
